body: A Mesa Airlines Embraer ERJ-175 operating on behalf of United, registration N87353, was performing flight UA-6144 from Monterrey, Mexico, to Houston Intercontinental, Texas, on October 26, 2026, when the crew reported brakes and steering problems while on approach to Houston. The aircraft continued for a safe landing on runway 09.

The aircraft was still on the ground in Houston about 5.5 hours after landing, according to The Aviation Herald report created and last updated on October 26, 2026, at 20:50Z. The report does not state the cause of the brakes and steering problems.
en.summary: A Mesa Airlines Embraer ERJ-175, registration N87353, operating United flight UA-6144 from Monterrey to Houston, reported brakes and steering problems on approach on October 26, 2026, and landed safely on runway 09; the aircraft was still on the ground in Houston about 5.5 hours later.
en.title: Mesa ERJ-175 lands safely at Houston after reporting brakes and steering problems on approach

body: 美莎航空一架代表聯合航空營運的巴西航空工業ERJ-175客機，註冊編號N87353，10月26日執飛自墨西哥蒙特雷前往美國休士頓洲際機場的UA-6144航班，在進近休士頓時機組通報煞車與轉向問題，該機隨後繼續進近並安全降落於09跑道。
根據The Aviation Herald於2026年10月26日20時50分（UTC）建立並更新的事件紀錄，該機降落約5.5小時後仍停留在休士頓地面，來源未進一步說明煞車與轉向問題的成因。
